name: lum-pet-cathedral
description: Lum, Wolverine, and Cutie ASCII scene forge with an in-chat MCP Apps wizard and native host-model generation.

interface.longDescription: An in-chat wizard for compact Lum, Wolverine, and Cutie ASCII/emoticon scenes. The completed form is sent back to the host chat for native model generation, so no provider API key is required by the plugin.
defaultPrompt: @Lum Pet Cathedral open the scene wizard.
